profileText: a Delegate from New Jersey; born in Nottingham, Prince Georges County, Md., November 14, 1740; received a classical education; studied medicine in Scotland, and commenced practice in Salem, N.J., in 1770; member of the New Jersey Provincial congress in 1776; served in the Revolutionary War; was appointed colonel of the First Battalion, Salem County Militia, in 1776; assistant surgeon in the Continental Army in the Canadian campaign; member of the first New Jersey state general assembly; appointed collector of customs for the western district of New Jersey in 1778; Delegate to the Confederation Congress, 1784 and 1785; delegate to the New Jersey state convention in 1787 to ratify the U.S. Constitution; surrogate of Salem County 1785-1804; died in Salem, Salem County, N.J., November 16, 1812; interment in St. John's Episcopal Churchyard.
